title: 第675章 离家出走的叶云第674章 你还真是妻管严
slug: 人在废丹房我以丹药证道成仙
content_zh:
“自然是让仙儿安心一下。”
叶云耸了耸肩，无奈的说道。
“刚才那情况，你又不是没看到。”
“我就算是继续掰扯下去，恐怕也说服不了仙儿。”
听到这里，南宫九天隐隐明白他想做什么了。
“所以，你就打算……”
她吃了一惊，诧异的道。
“没错！”
叶云咧嘴一笑，望了眼窗外的艳阳高照。
“等到天黑之时，咱们就悄悄出去。”
“到时候就让轻烟说，我在闭关的关键时刻，想来足够争取一段时间了。”
既然不让明着离开，那就偷偷的溜走。
在叶云看来，想混出去可太简单了。
见此，南宫九天赞许的点点头。
“不错不错，你倒是懂得变通了。”
说完，她话锋一转玩味道。
“但你就不怕，万一暴露了，回头该怎么跟你的小娘子解释？”
“这……管她呢。”
叶云也是看开了，毫不客气的摊了下手。
“反正仙儿又不会真把我怎么样，大不了就跪一下搓衣板。”

叶云这也算是，用最硬气的态度，说着最怂的话。
一旁的南宫九天，都不由笑了下。
“可以，那就这么办吧。”
就在这时，叶云看了她一眼，幽幽道。
“关键还是前辈，我这要是偷跑出去，小命可都交给你了。”
如今在他手中，能够作为保命底牌的金琉璃的传送卷轴没了。
唯一剩下的云霄城主的传送卷轴，总归不敢百分百肯定她会尽力帮自己。
所以真要算底牌的话，还得看南宫九天这边……
“知道了，这你就不必担心。”
南宫九天瞥了他一眼，淡淡道。
“本座答应的事，还从不会食言。”
“好咧，那就一言为定。”
叶云咧嘴一笑，放心下来。
毫无疑问，他自己也确实想出去，亲自去探究一番。
若非如此，南宫九天要不给点实质性的好处，他都不可能出去。
在与南宫九天约定好以后，叶云也离开书房。
白天的时候，在后面苍月醒来之后。
叶云还有模有样，为她说了下自己要闭关的事情。
对此，苍月自然是没什么意见。
content_en:
"Of course it makes Xian'er feel at ease."
Ye Yun shrugged and said helplessly.
"It's not like you didn't see what happened just now."
"Even if I continue to argue, I'm afraid I still won't be able to convince Xian'er."
After hearing this, Nangong Jiutian vaguely understood what he wanted to do.
"So, you are going to..."
She was taken aback and said in surprise.
"That's right!"
Ye Yun grinned and looked at the bright sun shining outside the window.
"When it gets dark, we will go out quietly."
"Let Qingyan say it when the time comes, I'm at the critical moment of seclusion and I think it's enough to fight for a while."
Since you are not allowed to leave obviously, then sneak away secretly.
In Ye Yun's view, it was too easy to get out.
Seeing this, Nangong Jiutian nodded in approval.
"Not bad, you know how to be flexible."
After saying that, she changed the topic to something fun.
"But you are not afraid. If you are exposed, how will you explain it to your little wife later?"
"It... doesn't matter to her."
Ye Yun also looked away and spread his hands unceremoniously.
"Anyway, Xian'er won't really do anything to me. In the worst case, I'll just kneel on the washboard."
Ye Yun could be considered as using the toughest attitude and saying the most cowardly words.
Nangong Jiutian, who was on the side, couldn't help but smile.
"Okay, let's do it."
At this moment, Ye Yun glanced at her and said quietly.
"The key is senior. If I sneak out now, my life will be in your hands."
Now in his hand, Jin Liuli's teleportation scroll, which could be used as a life-saving trump card, is gone.
The only remaining teleportation scroll of Yunxiao City Lord is still not 100% sure that she will try her best to help him.
So if you really want to count the trump card, you have to look at Nangong Jiutian...
"I know, you don't have to worry about that."
Nangong Jiutian glanced at him and said calmly.
"I will never break my promise."
"Okay, then it's settled."
Ye Yun grinned and felt relieved.
There is no doubt that he himself does want to go out and explore it himself.
If not, it would be impossible for Nangong Jiutian to go out without giving him some substantial benefits.
After making an agreement with Nangong Jiutian, Ye Yun also left the study.
During the day, after Cang Yue woke up.
Ye Yun was still presentable and told her about his retreat.
Cang Yue naturally had no objections to this.
